mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not positively correlated with declines in FEDFUNDS, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite rising unemployment, or if the mechanism fails in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply chain issues, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines by >1.0pp in one month
failure_condition: If industrial production decline does not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns, or if the mechanism fails in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) show weakness, it signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the joint weakness in UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals weakening demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth slowdown does not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns, or if the mechanism fails in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low and unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals potential economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of low FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE does not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
